contentBlocks.description: Everything you need to know about when SASSA pays the Child Support Grant, how payment method affects timing, and what to do when money does not arrive on time.

contentBlocks.frequency: Monthly (Top-Up for orphans: R830 per month)
contentBlocks.targetGroup: Primary caregivers of children under 18 who qualify for the Child Support Grant.

contentBlocks.text: How the CSG Payment Cycle Works

SASSA pays the Child Support Grant every month, usually during the first week. The exact date depends on your grant type — SASSA staggers payments so that not every grant is paid on the same day. CSG payments typically start on the first working day of the month and continue over the next few days. If the first of the month falls on a weekend or public holiday, payments shift to the next working day.

contentBlocks.title: Dates may shift on public holidays
contentBlocks.text: If the scheduled date falls on a public holiday, SASSA moves the payment to the nearest working day. This table already accounts for that. Bookmark this page or check the SASSA social media channels for any last-minute changes.

contentBlocks.text: What to Do If Your Payment Does Not Arrive

contentBlocks.title: Payment not arrived? Try these steps first
contentBlocks.text: Before heading to a SASSA office, check your bank app or SMS inbox. Payments sometimes land later in the day. If it is still missing after 24 hours, call SASSA on 0800 60 10 11 or visit your nearest office with your ID and payment reference number. Do not pay anyone to help you chase a missing payment — SASSA's services are free.

faqs.question: What date each month is the Child Support Grant paid?
faqs.answer: CSG is paid during the first few working days of each month, usually starting on the 1st or 2nd. SASSA publishes a schedule per grant type at the start of each year. Check the table above for the exact remaining dates for 2026.

faqs.question: Can I get backpay if my payment was late or missed?
faqs.answer: If SASSA missed a payment due to an administrative error, they will catch it up in the next cycle. If you received a payment date and the money simply did not reflect, contact SASSA and they will investigate. Keep your payment reference number safe.

faqs.question: What should I do if I miss my payment date entirely?
faqs.answer: Your money does not disappear. If you miss your date, the payment stays available. Go to your nearest SASSA office or retail paypoint with your ID and ask them to release it. If you use bank transfer, the money will usually still arrive within a day or two.

faqs.question: Does the CSG get paid on public holidays?
faqs.answer: No. If the scheduled payment date falls on a public holiday, SASSA moves it to the nearest working day before or after the holiday. The table above already accounts for this.

faqs.question: Can someone else collect my payment for me?
faqs.answer: Yes, but they need a signed letter from you and a copy of your ID. Some paypoints also require the collector to bring their own ID. If you plan to send someone regularly, ask your SASSA office to register them as an authorised collector.
